chunks: And Dāwūd ibn Sirḥān narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic,
He عليه السلام said: "The witness is the day of Jumuʿah.

key_terms.شَاهِدٍ: the witness; interpreted here as Friday
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the statement or verse of Allah
key_terms.مَشْهُودٍ: the witnessed; the counterpart mentioned in the verse
key_terms.يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, identified here as the witness

ai.seo_question: What does "the witness" mean in the verse "By the witness and the witnessed"?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase "By the witness and the witnessed" by identifying the "witness" as the day of Jumuʿah. It reflects a tafsir transmitted from Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام and highlights the spiritual significance of Friday in Islamic worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1244 - Dawud ibn Sirhan narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)
regarding the verse of Allah (swt), the Exalted,
"By the witness and the witnessed" (Surah Al-Buruj 85:3).
Imam (as) said: "The 'witness' is the day of Jumu’ah."
